svg.title: Hux V1-PROOF Complete system wiring by location
svg.desc: Rear elevation of the R05 body. Robot LEFT (near wall) is at the left. Each board sits where it mounts. Ports are connector positions. Every harness conductor is drawn. Source-checked planning drawing; proposed harnesses and unresolved interfaces require physical verification.
svg.text: Rear elevation of the R05 body. Robot LEFT (near wall) is at the left. Each board sits where it mounts. Ports are connector positions. Every harness conductor is drawn.
Rev C | Source: 17 OCT 2026 | Print layout: 17 OCT 2026
17 x 11 in / landscape / 0.5 in margins / print at 100%. Sources and open checks: docs/wiring-atlas.md.
CTRL DECK · Z +170 · near half: IMU · far half: Pico 2
BUS DECK · Z +120 · near half: power distribution · far half: spare cassette position
PWR DECK · Z +60 · near half: kill chain · far half: driver board
UNDER THE DECKS · leg junction board under the PWR deck · 3S pack on the tray at Z −35
fixture buttons, pack lead, left gearmotor

g.text: down the front face of the body
Was the servo bus and the encoder conversion. No board in V1-PROOF.
The encoder dividers sit on JLEG.
Bundle cut lengths → EL-06 and the harness register.
Dots connect. Gaps at crossings do not.
Dashed boards need part selection and bench checks.
BLACK wheel lead is switched OUT2, not ground.
XH = JST XH 2.50 mm. XT30 = 12 V power path.
RP2350 · 3.3 V GPIO · eight XH headers in contiguous pin groups · GP25 LED onboard
Headers: PH-A p4–p7, PH-A2 p8–p10, PH-B p11–p15, PH-C p16–p21,
PH-D p24–p29, PH-E p31–p34, PH-F p36–p39, PH-G p1–p3.
Desolder the pre-soldered pins, then solder the XH headers to the board (2026-10-17).
NC: ADC_VREF p35, RUN p30, 3V3_EN p37, GP17 p22, GP19–GP21.
EL-02 shows the physical board and the IMU pins.
3.3 V · main SPI pads · open the ADDR jumper for SPI · EL-02
JMAIN: B6B-XH-A on the six main pads.
Ports are in cable order; the position
From the unswitched fused bus. D5 Schottky → VSYS.
Logic stays on through a kill. 5 V to JLEG.
LD1117V33 gate logic from the bus.
Not ordered or tested. K0–K6 open.
DL, DR: Pololu 4035 / DRV8874 carriers on one 52 x 38 mm board · EL-03, EL-05
10 kΩ nFAULT pull-ups to 3V3. 1 kΩ CS series.
VREF divider ≈ 2.8 V (≈ 2.5 A). PMODE, IMODE to GND. VM NC.
nSLEEP from GP10 to both carriers.
EN low = brake. nSLEEP low = outputs off.
OUT1 / OUT2 go to JLEG, not to the motor directly.
Accepted 2026-10-17 · under the PWR deck · 1x6 pigtail headers · 2.2 kΩ / 3.3 kΩ dividers
Motor leads pass to JPL / JPR. Encoder A / B 5 V → 3.0 V → JENC.
Board layout, mount detail and the service loop for later leg motion remain open.
The pack sits on the tray at the bottom of the body. It is drawn
here so that its lead to the kill chain is clear.
Both buttons are on the bench fixture, not on the robot.
Micro-USB cable to the front of the Pico 2.
